_comment: Copy this file to routing.config.json and edit it for YOUR setup. Each category maps to a Sonarr/Radarr root folder + quality-profile id that whatsarr passes to Seerr as a per-request override. rootFolder must be a path that exists on your *arr host; profileId is the numeric quality-profile id (find it in Sonarr/Radarr > Settings > Profiles, or via their /api/v3/qualityprofile endpoint). 'western' is the default category used when a request has no explicit one, so it must be present under both movies and tv. forbiddenPath is an optional regex; any resolved rootFolder matching it is refused (defense in depth for curated/off-limits libraries). routing.config.json is gitignored.
